lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from high-density small clusters anteriorly to larger, discrete nodes mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the dorsal edge and a low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, non-linear swirling or labyrinthine pattern of high-luminance pixels is located on the dorsal-anterior region, immediately posterior to the head.
